header: Places to join and how active each is
lead: Forum, chat, user group, mailing list or code repository. Each gets a card with its purpose and roughly how many people are there.
note: Put member counts in each description. They go out of date quickly, so round them or leave them out.

places.title: TYPO3 Talk
places.description: The community forum, for questions, answers and announcements.

places.title: TYPO3 Slack
places.description: The community chat, with a channel for each topic and region. Joining is free.

places.title: TYPO3 on GitHub
places.description: The source code of the TYPO3 core, to read, fork and learn from.

places.title: TYPO3 Forge
places.description: The issue tracker, where bugs are reported and their fixes followed.
